title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It is often used to make data easy to explore and visualize.

title: Variance in PCA
text: In PCA, the first principal component captures the most variance, and each subsequent component captures the remaining variance in decreasing order.

title: Orthogonality of Principal Components
text: Principal components are orthogonal to each other, meaning they are uncorrelated.
